lead.event: Rupiah reaches successive record lows against the US dollar
lead.headline: Rupiah hits successive record lows at Rp18,400 per US dollar
lead.blurb: It closed at Rp18,332 on 25 November, its lowest level at the time, then fell 68 points or 0.37% by 11:48 on 26 November. October trade and November inflation data are due the following week.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

market_structure_policy.event: IDX excludes High Shareholding Concentration stocks from JCI weighting
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX sets JCI weighting exclusion for HSC stocks on 383-issuer list
market_structure_policy.blurb: The exchange cited higher price-fluctuation risk and potential tracking error for passive investors. Krom Bank, whose shareholding concentration is 99.94%, is exploring consolidation and awaits new OJK rules.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia cuts conventional banks' reserve requirement to 7%
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts conventional banks' reserve requirement to 7% from 1 December
market_structure_policy.blurb: BI has also lowered the macroprudential liquidity incentive limit from 6% to 5%. The reserve requirement fell from 9% to 8% on 1 November and reaches 7% on 1 December, leaving effective GWM at 2% for banks receiving the maximum incentive.

other.event: Adaro Andalan Indonesia announces US$500 million interim dividend
other.headline: AADI announces US$500 million interim dividend
other.blurb: The dividend is double the US$250 million paid in 2025 and will come from net profit for the nine months ended 30 September. The per-share amount has not been announced, and the cum-dividend date for regular and negotiation markets is 3 December, with payment scheduled for 11 December.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

other.event: Adhi Karya secures Rp1.29 trillion contract for 26 irrigation projects
other.headline: ADHI secures Rp1.29 trillion contract for 26 irrigation projects
other.blurb: The award directly impacts Adhi Karya's construction order backlog. Further details were not available.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia obtains approval for 6.8 billion-share rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS obtains approval for rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: There is no standby buyer, and shareholders who do not exercise their rights face dilution of up to 12.85%. Shareholders approved the capital increase on 6 November, with rights scheduled to trade and be exercised from 18 to 24 February 2027.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: There is no standby buyer, and shareholders who do not exercise their rights face dilution of up to 12.85%.

deals_control.event: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.headline: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.blurb: The investment was made through subsidiary Tunas Harapan Perkasa in Nasdaq-listed HighPeak Energy. Energi Mega Persada said it targets operational synergies and technology transfer, with the deal potentially adding around 47 million barrels of oil equivalent in economic exposure to its 14-asset portfolio.

deals_control.event: Trimegah Sekuritas executes Rp278.84 billion reverse repo of Energi Mega Persada shares
deals_control.headline: TRIM executes Rp278.84 billion reverse repo of ENRG shares
deals_control.blurb: Trimegah Sekuritas completed the transaction on 25 November at Rp555 per share for 502.42 million shares. Its ENRG holdings fell to 4.26 billion shares, or 10.71%, from 4.76 billion shares, or 11.97%.

deals_control.event: BCA Sekuritas acquires 5.41% stake in Darma Henwa
deals_control.headline: BCA Sekuritas acquires 5.41% stake in DEWA
deals_control.blurb: BCA Sekuritas bought 2.2 billion shares on 24 November for an estimated Rp490.55 billion, according to Stockbit's estimate based on KSEI data. Darma Henwa shares rose 1.71% to Rp238 on 26 November.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades Indonesian telecommunications sector to Neutral
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades Indonesian telecom sector to Neutral, cuts targets 26%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas cited MSCI reclassification risk to Standalone Market and rising US rate expectations, not weak operations. It raised the sector’s cost of equity to 16.5-17.5% from 14.0-14.5% and estimated US$850 million in potential foreign outflows, including about Rp15 trillion from TLKM. EXCL is its top pick, with a buy rating and Rp2,850 target.

earnings_guidance.headline: BUMI reports 404.9% rise in nine-month attributable profit to US$148.47 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Receivables owed to Bumi Resources by Jhonlin Group rose to US$127 million, or 51% of trade receivables, from US$14 million a year earlier. Revenue increased 38.85% to US$1.44 billion for the nine months ended 30 September.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: Receivables owed by Jhonlin Group rose to US$127 million and represented 51% of trade receivables.

earnings_guidance.event: Hana Bank reports nine-month 2026 earnings and loan growth
earnings_guidance.headline: Hana Bank reports Rp541.86 billion profit and 8.03% loan growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Operating expenses fell to Rp656.97 billion from Rp776.19 billion, supporting 12.63% year-on-year profit growth. Gross and net NPLs were 0.44% and 0.18%. Director Hendri Setiawan said Hana Bank was optimistic about meeting its 2026 target and planned credit optimization and retail expansion in 2027.
